summary: First Real Estate Investment Trust of New Jersey (FREIT) filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Third Amendment to its Management Agreement with external manager Hekemian Company, tied to a Plan of Voluntary Liquidation under Item 8.01. The amendment sets termination fees of 2.5 times one year's Base Management Fee per property and a 1.65% sales fee upon disposition of managed properties. The company is liquidating its entire direct or indirect interest in each property, triggering automatic termination of the management contract and payouts. Watch for property sale timelines and shareholder distributions as the liquidation progresses.
